verdict.rationale: Helicone publishes a REST API reference with per-endpoint pages, for example POST /v1/request/query with a copy-pasteable curl example. A probe confirmed a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.helicone.ai/swagger.json. The evidence does not show that the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser, so only the core reference and sample code are established. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive 'try it' playground in the API reference, runnable in-page examples, multi-language snippets, and independent corroboration of the reference experience.
